windows.60: Over the past 60 days, visitors have noted issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, particularly regarding limited menu options and long wait times. Several reviews mentioned that the food quality did not meet expectations, with specific complaints about the preparation and variety of items offered. Wait times for ordering were also a problem, with at least one report of a significant delay due to kitchen backups. While the overall rating remains positive, these operational concerns around food and service should be addressed to improve the visitor experience.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many found the menu limited, overpriced, and the food quality below expectations, with specific complaints about portion sizes, taste, and preparation. Service problems included long wait times and inconsistent availability of menu items, leading to frustration among guests. While the library itself receives positive remarks, the café’s current food offerings and service logistics need attention to improve visitor satisfaction.
